name: Deep Sleep → On Wake
description:
An automation to run when the device boots after waking from deep sleep. Only on ESP32, ESP8266 and BK72xx. See [`on_wake` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/deep_sleep/#on_wake-trigger).

This automation runs once at boot when the device wakes from deep sleep. It does not run after a cold boot, a reset or a restart (for example after an OTA update). It is available on ESP32, ESP8266 and BK72xx.
